name: Portfolio turnover

subjectOf.text: Average unconstrained mutual fund portfolio turnover exceeds the turnover of other fixed income mutual funds by over 150 percent.
subjectOf.abstract: In particular, UMF turnover on average exceeds the turnover for other fixed income mutual funds by over 150 percent.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729
scope_conditions: Morningstar turnover data as of March 2016
comparison against all taxable bond funds, N equals 5543

subjectOf.text: The high turnover rate of unconstrained mutual funds distinguishes them from other mutual funds and makes them directly comparable to private funds, which typically trade at high levels.
subjectOf.abstract: The high UMF turnover rate is a characteristic that distinguishes these funds from other mutual funds, and makes them directly comparable to private funds, which typically engage in high trading levels
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729
scope_conditions: comparison of unconstrained mutual funds with private funds on trading intensity
